description: This file handles the Web-to-Person (lead) capture process in the SuiteCRM system, including form submission validation, creating or updating Person beans, linking campaign logs, handling email opt-ins, and redirecting users appropriately.

classes.name: SuiteValidator
classes.description: Utility class used for validation, such as checking if an ID is valid.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving bean instances like Person, Campaigns, Users, etc.

classes.name: DBManagerFactory
classes.description: Factory class providing database management instances.

classes.name: TimeDate
classes.description: Class providing current time and date functionalities.

classes.name: SugarEmailAddress
classes.description: Class managing email address-related operations, such as adding, updating, and resetting opt-in status.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: Class providing configuration options, such as enabling email confirmations or opt-in procedures.

classes.name: EmailMan
classes.description: Class responsible for email sending, particularly for opt-in confirmation emails.

methods.name: create_guid
methods.description: Generates a new globally unique identifier (GUID).

methods.name: filterFieldsFromBeans
methods.description: Filters and extracts fields from bean objects for form processing.

methods.name: isWebToLeadAllowedRedirectHost
methods.description: Validates whether a redirect URL host is allowed for web-to-lead form submissions.
